newsitem.title: USA: Sun, Retirement Care amend merger terms.
newsitem.headline: Sun, Retirement Care amend merger terms.

text.p: Sun Healthcare Group Inc and Retirement Care Associates Inc said on Thursday that they have amended the terms of their merger agreement.
The amendment changes the number of shares of Sun stock that would be issued for each share of Retirement Care to 0.68265 from 0.6625, the companies said.
The change reflects an agreement for Sun to retain Retirement Care's ownership interest in In-House Rehab Corp, the companies said.
The amended agreement does not affect Sun's related merger agreement with Contour Medical Inc, which is 65-percent owned by Retirement Care, the companies said.

The original merger agreement with Retirement Care called for Sun to sell Retirement Care's ownership interest in In-House Rehab -- about 3.5 million shares -- for Retirement Care's basis in the stock, the companies said.
The amended agreement now calls for Sun to issue about 350,000 additional shares of common stock to Retirement Care shareholders, and to retain Retirement Care's ownership interest in In-House Rehab.
Sun and Retirement Care said they expect the merger to close in the third quarter.
